workflow: 1. Contributions arrive by email via Web3Forms
3. Approved entries are manually added to the MISCONCEPTIONS array in index.html
4. Each approved entry must include all required fields below
5. Push to main branch — Cloudflare deploys automatically

_approved_entry_template.title: Short title of the misconception (5-8 words)
_approved_entry_template.myth: The exact misconception as people state it on X.
_approved_entry_template.reality: The evidence-backed rebuttal. Maximum 3 sentences. Cite institutions by name.

_contributor_scoring.description: Each approved contribution earns points. Display name is credited on the site.
_contributor_scoring.note: Scores are manually tracked. Update contributorScore in each entry when contributor has multiple accepted submissions.
